## What's new in 1.4.9
- **Cleaner menu bar menu.** Pick your microphone right from the top of the menu, start a **New Recording** in one click, or control an active recording with **Pause**, **Draw** and **Stop**. Your **Last recording** stays right there with **Copy link**, **Show in Finder**, **Make/Copy AI prompt**, and **Retry upload**. - **Smarter readiness checks.** Closing the recorder window keeps the menu bar **Ready** while releasing your camera, microphone and screen. If a permission is off or a camera isn't sending video, the menu offers a one-click fix (**Open System Settings** or **Turn Camera off**). - **Simpler General settings.** **Settings → General** opens in a compact window with **Appearance**, **Open at Login**, **Check for Updates…** and **Report a Problem…** up front, and expands automatically when you switch to **Workspaces**. - **Last recording on every Freestyle tab.** Your newest saved Freestyle recording stays one click away whether you are on **Record**, **Look** or **Audio**. - **Collapsible sidebar and wider script panel.** Click the bottom-left sidebar button to collapse controls to a slim status + Record strip, and drag the divider beside your Studio script to widen it up to half the window. - **Separate source files for Studio takes.** Studio now saves full, uncropped camera, screen and microphone files in a `Sources` folder beside each take so you can reframe in post (toggle in **Settings → General**). - **Fixed:** Framed layout in Freestyle no longer shows a duplicate floating camera bubble on the desktop.

## What's new in 1.4.8
- **Framed layout.** Show your screen in a rounded window on a backdrop, with the camera in its own tile beside it. Pick it under Layout in Freestyle, or under Arrange in Studio landscape. - **New menu bar panel.** The menu bar icon now opens a panel with status, your microphone, recent recordings and quick actions. The app shows in the Dock while the recorder window is open. - **Spoken bullets in scripts.** A line starting with `> -` shows on the prompter as a bullet you read aloud. A stage note right before a slide shows as a small subtitle under that slide's heading. - **Warnings clear themselves.** "Could not select microphone" and "screen paused" messages go away once the problem is fixed. - **Simpler Audio tab.** One hint appears only when your chosen input is silent and another input has sound. - The "Take saved" strip is one compact row and clears when you move to the next video. - Fixed: after quitting or updating, the app could fail to reopen its window. - AI agents can now check and fix your recording setup, and can load a script the moment it is written.

## What's new in 1.4.7
- **Welcome setup for new installs.** Pick Studio or Freestyle, allow only the permissions that mode needs (one at a time), then make an optional 10-second test recording. - **Report a Problem…** in the menu bar menu and Help menu. It saves a small report to your Desktop with app and Mac details. No video, audio or file names. - **Clearer save messages.** If a video saves but its details file doesn't, the app says so and offers Try Again instead of "Not saved". - **Make prompt works without a coding tool.** With neither Claude Code nor Codex installed, it writes a prompt you can paste into any AI chat. - Studio with a camera-only layout no longer asks for Screen Recording. - Script files show as "Freestyle Studio Script" in Finder.

Freestyle Studio 1.4.6 gives Freestyle a tidier sidebar.
- **Record, Look and Audio tabs.** Freestyle's sidebar now works like Studio's. Record holds the title, screen, camera, mic level and your last recording. Look holds the bubble size, shape and highlights. Audio holds every audio setting. Mode and Record stay pinned on top, and each mode remembers its own tab. Nothing was removed.

Freestyle Studio 1.4.5 makes long Google Drive uploads finish.
- **Uploads keep going after a network blip.** If one piece of an upload fails (a dropped connection or a busy Google server), the app waits and tries again for up to about two minutes, then carries on from where Drive left off. Before, one failed piece stopped the whole upload with "Could not reach Google." - **Works for both modes.** Freestyle share uploads and Studio take uploads use the same retry.

Freestyle Studio 1.4.4 is simpler, faster and more reliable.
- **Take saved strip.** After a Studio take, a small strip stays up with Play, Record another take and More. Record another take starts a new numbered take and keeps the old one. - **Fewer buttons.** The Freestyle Last recording card shows Play, Share, Make prompt and More. Studio tabs show one Layout row, slide options only for scripts with slides, and profile editing under Preview options. - **Keep your share link.** After an upload, the link stays visible with Copy link and Open link. - **Reliable Record and Stop.** Record can't start twice, Stop works right after the countdown, and the full audio is written before a take says Saved. - **Faster.** Menus open from a cached list, the app no longer checks the takes folder twice a second, and an unchanged screen source keeps running. - **Clearer labels.** Adjust framing, Show in Finder, and Stop scrolling at slide end. The permissions button opens the setting that is actually missing.

Freestyle Studio 1.4.3 labels the script's read time.
- **Clear read time.** The Script tab now shows Words and Est. time on separate rows, with a short line under the time that splits it into speaking and pauses at your current pace.

Freestyle Studio 1.4.2 keeps your Google sign-in in the Workspace form.
- **Sign in once.** Settings > Workspaces now remembers the Google account you signed in with, even after you close Settings or restart the app.

Freestyle Studio 1.4.1 makes adding a Workspace easier.
- **SOP folder is optional.** Settings > Workspaces now needs only a name and a Google account. You can add the SOP folder later.

Freestyle Studio 1.4.0 makes the Studio sidebar simpler and the script editor more forgiving.
- **Sidebar tabs.** Studio settings are now split into Film, Video, Audio and Script. Film holds what changes from take to take: the script, format, platform, layout, Framer, font size and pace. - **Edit the script during a take.** Edit stays available while recording. It opens at the sentence you were reading, and saving returns you to the same spot. - **Return adds a line.** In the script editor, Return now starts a new line where your cursor is. - **Video IDs.** Give a script an ID such as VID-0042 from the title editor (the pencil on the title card). The ID shows on the title card and is saved with every take. - **Automation setting.** Settings > General has a new switch, off by default, that lets automation tools on your Mac control the recorder.
A take keeps the script snapshot it started with, even if you edit the script while recording.
